title: Border enforcement policy takes effect as legal challenges mount
summary: The border enforcement policy took effect Monday. Civil rights groups filed lawsuits and a boycott of contractor firms was announced.

title: Thousands march against border enforcement policy in three cities
summary: Organizers said thousands joined a march against the border policy; a petition gathered signatures.

title: Border policy takes effect amid protests, officials defend enforcement
summary: The enforcement policy took effect Monday as protests continued; officials defended the border policy.

title: Death toll rises to 5 in capital demonstration clashes
summary: Officials said 5 people died in clashes at the demonstration; a general strike was called.

title: Toll from demonstration clashes rises to 6, general strike called
summary: Medics said 6 people died in the clashes at the demonstration as unions called a general strike.
